series: Theory and Research Note No. 3.4 · November 2026
title: The Energy Transition Swaps a Fuel Bill for a Capital Bill

slides.title: The Energy Transition Swaps a Fuel Bill for a Capital Bill
slides.subtitle: Stylized facts, the literature behind them, and what they mean for macroeconomic policy, carbon pricing and development finance
slides.message: A fuel-based energy system is paid for every day; an electric one is paid for when it is built. Energy moves from the trade balance to the balance sheet, so finance and credibility matter as much as the carbon price.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity

slides.title: A transition that pays may still come too late, which is the case for a global green deal

left.title: What the facts imply
items: Report the cost of capital as an energy price
Judge carbon pricing by the whole effective price and by whether it is believed
Put commitments in contracts, and count the liabilities
Watch guarantees, state companies and fuel tax erosion, not only subsidies

right.title: What one country cannot do alone
items: Capture the fall in cost that its deployment causes
Stop fuel it saves from being burned elsewhere
Create more of the standing of lenders who are paid first
